title: Rooftop Deck | ADA Condo, 10 Min to Broadway
description:
Welcome to your East Nashville retreat — an ADA-accessible apartment 10 minutes from Broadway and the Opry, ideal for short or long stays. Fully equipped kitchen, dedicated work table, in-unit washer/dryer, toiletries, and warm neon and string lighting. The building offers free parking and a rooftop deck with seating, a fireplace, and downtown skyline views. Butcher & Bee, The Pharmacy, and Kroger are close by, and a coffee shop is next door. New smart thermostat (2026) holds your set temp.

The space
An ADA-accessible one-bedroom condo in East Nashville with a full kitchen, in-unit washer and dryer, a dedicated work table, and a warm neon-and-string-light vibe. The building's rooftop deck has seating, a fireplace, and downtown skyline views. A coffee shop sits right next door, and downtown and Broadway are about 10 minutes away.

Guest access
The apartment is all yours, plus access to the building's rooftop deck. Smart-lock self check-in and parking for 1 car.

Other things to note
Maximum 1 pet allowed with a $55 non-refundable pet fee.
